purpose: Teach: アンダー/ハリケーン/レバー/セクハラ/ワープロ/メトロ/合気道/ダイヤル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアンダーシャツを着てらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to wear an undershirt.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic recall. Settling into memory. Slow, even pace. A tender observation, not quite a story—just placing something in the past.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ハリケーンの体験談を語ってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—your grandfather used to tell us all about his hurricane experience, remember?
lines.style: Warm agreement with a slight turn inward. Nodding along with her own memory. Affectionate on 'dear.' A pause before the question, inviting him back into the moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがビールのレバーを上手に扱われたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was quite skilled at working the beer tap.
lines.style: Same wistful settling. A small smile in the voice. The detail feels precise, held carefully. Pause between clauses, letting each piece settle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、セクハラという言葉を初めて聞かれた時、驚かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Dear, your grandfather was so surprised the first time he heard the word sexual harassment.
lines.style: Gentle amusement underneath. Not mocking—tenderly amused at how times have changed. Her voice lifts slightly on the memory. Warm on the term, almost protective of his innocence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがワープロで手紙を書かれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to write letters on a word processor.
lines.style: Continuing the thread. Same wistful tone. A beat of quietness before 'word processor'—the specific detail landing softly, as if picturing it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、東京のメトロを楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather enjoyed the Tokyo metro so much, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Brightest moment yet. The energy lifts on 'Tokyo metro'—a fond memory she returns to gladly. Quick, engaged. The question lands with genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが合気道を習ってらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he studied aikido.
lines.style: Settling again into the wistful register. Quieter this time, almost reverent. The detail feels important. A pause after 'studied'—giving it weight.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ダイヤル式の電話を使ってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather used to use a dial telephone, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Closing the conversation. Warm and present, but with a note of finality. Affectionate on 'dear.' The pace slows slightly—she's drawing him close as the evening settles.
